content:
After releasing the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate yesterday, Apple has followed up with a public beta. Here are the details.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is now available

Last week, Apple announced that it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and move directly to the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. Yesterday, Apple released the second developer beta.

This move appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will launch on October 23 running iOS 27.1. iOS 27.1 will likely focus on specific features and changes for this new foldable device, leading Apple to push testing of its other operating systems straight to 27.2.

As for what's new in the current macOS 27.2 beta, the most notable addition is the expansion of languages supported by Siri AI, which is what Apple has promised to deliver in October. As of the second macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is build 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

To sign up for Apple's free public beta program, visit beta.apple.com.
